selected_evidence.requirement: Route authentication and authorization messages to /var/log/auth-events.log
selected_evidence.summary: The configuration is syntactically valid; auth and authpriv markers reached auth-events.log before and after reboot, while normal markers were absent.
syslog-ng and journald remained active, ordinary user-facility events reached /var/log/messages, and the current-boot journal retained all test events.

Healthy baseline boot 4eaf428d-1724-4431-a764-c9e0fdc350cc was captured, the safe reboot was acknowledged, boot changed to b2ab1512-0626-4e8d-a332-64fb658d10f4, services and prior records recovered, and fresh post-reboot routing checks passed.

config_syntax=valid
auth_file=/var/log/auth-events.log mode=640 owner=root group=log size=56437
normal_file=/var/log/messages mode=640 owner=root group=log size=213100
persisted_pre_reboot_records:
Sep  2 19:31:04 node1 auth-route-test[1099]: AUTH_FACILITY_PRE_REBOOT_20260902
Sep  2 19:31:04 node1 auth-route-test[1100]: AUTHPRIV_FACILITY_PRE_REBOOT_20260902
Sep  2 19:31:04 node1 normal-route-test[1101]: NORMAL_FACILITY_PRE_REBOOT_20260902

commands.command:
set -eu
logger -p auth.info -t auth-route-test AUTH_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902
logger -p authpriv.notice -t auth-route-test AUTHPRIV_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902
logger -p user.notice -t normal-route-test NORMAL_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902
sleep 1
printf '%s\n' 'post_reboot_auth_file:'
grep -F 'AUTH_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902' /var/log/auth-events.log
grep -F 'AUTHPRIV_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902' /var/log/auth-events.log
if grep -Fq 'NORMAL_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902' /var/log/auth-events.log; then printf '%s\n' 'normal_event_in_auth_file=FAIL'; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'normal_event_in_auth_file=absent'; fi
printf '%s\n' 'post_reboot_normal_file:'
grep -F 'NORMAL_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902' /var/log/messages
if grep -Fq 'AUTH_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902' /var/log/messages || grep -Fq 'AUTHPRIV_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902' /var/log/messages; then printf '%s\n' 'auth_event_in_normal_file=FAIL'; exit 1; else printf '%s\n' 'auth_events_in_normal_file=absent'; fi
printf '%s\n' 'post_reboot_current_boot_journal:'
journalctl -b --no-pager -o cat | grep -F 'FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902'
printf '%s\n' 'routing_checks=PASS'
commands.stdout:
post_reboot_auth_file:
Sep  2 19:32:01 node1 auth-route-test[457]: AUTH_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902
Sep  2 19:32:01 node1 auth-route-test[458]: AUTHPRIV_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902
normal_event_in_auth_file=absent
post_reboot_normal_file:
Sep  2 19:32:01 node1 normal-route-test[459]: NORMAL_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902
auth_events_in_normal_file=absent
post_reboot_current_boot_journal:
AUTH_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902
AUTHPRIV_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902
NORMAL_FACILITY_POST_REBOOT_20260902
routing_checks=PASS
